correctness.rationale: In the repaired theorem, all tuples are ordered, injective and disjoint from the individually named base. Homogeneity identifies their types with finite induced diagrams; different diagrams differ on an atomic formula. In one represented class with m_i old points, r increasing new points form a weak composition among m_i+1 gaps. Its count is binom(m_i+r,r), and distinct entries give r! coordinate labellings. For r>=1, assignment to different represented classes gives disjoint sets of types. Thus C_r is the sum of the monic degree-r polynomials product_{j=1}^r(m_i+j), a triangular transform of the power sums through degree r including p_0=k. The first k counts invert it and Newton's identities recover the degree-k polynomial with the class sizes as its roots. For k=0 all counts are zero and there is no multiset to reconstruct. Direct substitution gives C_2=6+20 versus 12+12 for (1,3) and (2,2); (1,2) versus (2,1) has equal multiset and pooled sequence, but a different ordered base. Their unrefined equality follows from the cited h=1 specialization; independently the n+k internal gaps and k+1 quotient gaps give exactly (1-z)^(1-n)/(1-2z)^(k+1). The original two-count inversion is also correct by logarithmic differentiation; it is removed as a claimed contribution, not as a mathematical error.
residual_risks: The bound of k observations is sufficient, not claimed sharp; C_1 is already determined if n and k are given. The channel loses class order and makes no assertion about tuple counts with repeated or named coordinates.

value.rationale: The surviving result gives finite identifiability for a natural observable in a classical homogeneous structure: among injective types, count just those satisfying the single common-represented-class condition, without identifying which class. The restricted counts recover a specific, order-invariant part of the base that not even all unrefined arities can supply. The two explicit examples distinguish recovery of a multiset from recovery of the full finite ordered structure. This is a mathematically motivated refinement with a usable reconstruction, not a repackaged unrefined spectrum or a claim of a new inversion method.
residual_risks: No claim is made that the number of observations is minimal or that the pooled data reconstruct the order of classes.
